name: Math Block Run
desc:
Challenge your friends to a fun math race in Math Block Run!

How to play:
1. Run to the finish line without falling.
2. Stand on the right answer before the timer hits zero.
3. Players who get to the end earn a win!

Roblox Premium Benefits: +10% Walkspeed and Daily Premium Rewards!

Join "AE MiniGames" to unlock the daily group rewards!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/16064887/AE-MiniGames

Leave a like if you enjoyed the game!

VIP Servers are free. You can play alone or invite your friends!

You can give us feedback and report bugs on our community wall.
